meta.purpose: Real-corpus retrieval benchmark: lexical baseline vs hybrid (semantic) retrieval, Hungarian and English queries over the actual stored memories.
meta.note: Ground truth is the exact stored text; the test resolves it to a block at runtime, so the fixture survives index rebuilds that renumber blocks.
